ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rectangle OABC, point A is on the x-axis, and point C is on the y-axis. The coordinates of point B are $\left(6, 8\right)$. Rectangle OABC is folded along line BD so that point C lands exactly on point E on the diagonal OB. The line of the fold BD intersects the y-axis and the x-axis at points D and F, respectively. What is the length of line segment OE?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since in rectangle OABC, point A is on the x-axis and point C is on the y-axis, with point B having the coordinates (6, 8),\\
it follows that OA = 6, AB = 8, and $\angle$OAB$=90^\circ$,\\
thus OB $= \sqrt{OA^{2} + AB^{2}} = \sqrt{6^{2} + 8^{2}} = 10$,\\
from folding, we know BE = BC = 6,\\
therefore, OE = OB - BE = 10 - 6 = \boxed{4};
